coordinates: Unity metres; +Y up, gameplay +Z forward; quaternions x/y/z/w. Camera FOV is vertical degrees; image aspect 16/9.
interpolation: Author root translation is cubic Hermite with explicit velocity tangents. Camera offsets, pitch and FOV use smoothstep between keys. Dense 30fps frames are authoritative: interpolate positions/FOV linearly and rotations with shortest-path slerp. Unity Timeline transform curves use linear frame tangents and normalized quaternion interpolation.

sourceModel.blenderMapping: Using ORIGINAL Blender source: world position (u.x,u.z,u.y), quaternion xyzw (-u.qx,-u.qz,-u.qy,u.qw). Camera position and target use the same Y/Z swap; camera local -Z points at target and local +Y is up. glTFast already mirrors source X; do not mirror nodes again.

animation.note: Existing seven wing/tail quaternion channels only; no authored takeoff clip. Animation owns bones, trajectory owns gameplay root.

handoff.note: Capture pose, velocity, lens and camera before stopping Timeline; restore captured values before transferring control. Replay from flight restores its captured pre-replay state.
